name: @papercupai/code2prompt
description: Diff-aware prompt context for the reviewer role. Wraps the code2prompt CLI to produce structured prompts showing what changed since a base ref. Bundled templates: code-review, security-audit, refactor-prep. Plus a generic `pack` tool for non-diff use cases.
author: Papercusp

tools.name: diff
tools.description: Build a diff-aware prompt showing what changed in the working tree (or vs a base ref). Reviewer's primary tool — combines code2prompt's git-diff support with a templated prompt for code review / security audit / refactor planning.

base.description: Git ref to diff against. Default: 'main'. Reviewer typically passes the harness's last_accepted_feature_sha (set when validator passes a feature).

include.description: Glob patterns to include in the diff. Default: all changed files.

template.description: Bundled prompt template applied to the diff. 'none' returns raw diff context.

guidance.when: Reviewer's primary tool — build a diff-aware prompt showing what changed (working tree or vs a base ref).
guidance.notWhen: For non-diff project packing, use `code2prompt.pack` or `repomix.pack`. diff is review-specific.

tools.name: pack
tools.description: Build a non-diff prompt over a project (or subset) — same shape as repomix.pack but uses code2prompt's templating. Useful when a reviewer wants a structured prompt, not a raw repo dump.

tokens.description: Include code2prompt's token count in the output header.

guidance.when: Pack a project (or subset) using code2prompt's templating — same shape as repomix.pack but different template engine.
guidance.notWhen: For a diff specifically, use `code2prompt.diff`. For most cases, either pack tool works; pick by template preference.

binary.description: Binary name on PATH. Override if you installed under a non-default name.

defaultBase.description: Default base ref for `diff` when input.base is unset.

inlineThresholdChars.description: Outputs smaller than this returned inline; larger ones written to .papercusp/scratch/ and returned as a path reference.
